All non-conformance reports must include the defect code from the standard taxonomy, a photograph with scale reference, and the operator's clock number, filed within 30 minutes of detection.

The overall equipment effectiveness calculation uses availability times performance times quality, with availability measured as run time divided by planned production time and a target OEE of 85 percent for the machining line.

The andon system uses a 3-color stack light: green for normal operation, yellow for material shortage with a 15-minute resolution window, and red for quality or safety stop that requires supervisor badge-in to clear.

current_user_input: What is the incident severity classification matrix and the containment playbook for ransomware?

recent_context.content: We are updating the incident response documentation.

candidate_memories.content: Incident severity is classified as Sev1 for confirmed data exfiltration or production outage affecting more than 10 percent of users, Sev2 for suspected compromise with initial access confirmed, Sev3 for policy violations or malware detected but contained on a single endpoint, and Sev4 for reconnaissance activity with no access gained.

The ransomware containment playbook is: isolate affected subnets within 5 minutes of confirmation, revoke all active sessions for users in affected domain, cut off backup replication links, preserve memory dumps and disk images of at least 3 affected hosts, and engage the incident response retainer within 15 minutes.
The EDR solution was migrated to CrowdStrike Falcon with the 1-10-60 benchmark: 1 minute to detect, 10 minutes to investigate, and 60 minutes to remediate.
All privileged access requires a PIM activation with a maximum duration of 4 hours and automatic revocation if the session is idle for more than 15 minutes.
The vulnerability disclosure program accepts reports through HackerOne with a response SLA of 48 hours for initial triage and a safe harbor clause for good-faith researchers.
A deception technology mesh using honey tokens in S3 buckets with canary alerts wired into the SOAR playbook is being added.

current_user_input: Which network segmentation standard and data classification labels are enforced?

candidate_memories.content: Network segmentation follows a zero-trust architecture with micro-segmentation at the workload level using application-aware firewall rules; PCI and PII workloads reside in dedicated security zones with east-west traffic inspection.

Data classification uses four labels: Public for marketing materials and docs, Internal for engineering specs and runbooks, Confidential for customer PII and financial data requiring DLP monitoring, and Restricted for encryption keys and secrets with access logged and reviewed quarterly.

All database access requires an ephemeral certificate issued by HashiCorp Vault with a maximum TTL of 24 hours, and production write access requires a break-glass justification stored in the audit log.
The SIEM correlation engine processes 80,000 events per second with 350 detection rules tuned to a signal-to-noise target of less than 50 alerts per day for the tier-1 SOC queue.

current_user_input: How does the audience segmentation engine and the attribution model work?

recent_context.content: The marketing analytics team needs the segmentation and attribution details.

candidate_memories.content: The audience segmentation engine computes RFM segments nightly using a k-means clustering with k equals 7, integrating first-party web events, CRM purchase history, and email engagement scores into a unified customer profile.

The attribution model uses a data-driven Shapley value approach across the full conversion path with a 30-day lookback window and a 24-hour holdout for incrementality testing against a 5 percent randomized control group.

All email campaigns must be A/B tested on a 10 percent sample for 2 hours before full send, with the winning variant selected automatically on click-through rate with a 95 percent confidence threshold.

The CDP identity resolution merges profiles on hashed email as the primary key and hashed phone as the secondary key, with a 24-hour staleness window for newly ingested events before they appear in segments.
The creative variant generation pipeline uses a diffusion model fine-tuned on the brand asset library with guardrails for text legibility and brand color palette adherence.
A real-time personalization engine that adjusts homepage hero content and product recommendations based on in-session behavior signals is being added.

current_user_input: What is the push notification frequency cap and the churn prediction threshold?

candidate_memories.content: Push notification frequency is capped at 3 per user per day across all campaigns, with a quiet period from 10pm to 7am local time and an automatic suppression for users who have not opened a push in the last 21 days.

The churn prediction model flags a user for a retention campaign when the 14-day churn probability exceeds 0.35, using a gradient-boosted model with features for session recency, purchase frequency decline, and support ticket sentiment.
All SMS campaigns require opt-in via a double-opt-in flow with a confirmation keyword, and the opt-out rate is monitored with an alert if it exceeds 2 percent in any 7-day window.
The app review response team must reply to all reviews with 3 stars or fewer within 48 hours using a templated response approved by the brand team.

current_user_input: What is the flight computer redundancy architecture and the telemetry downlink schedule?

recent_context.content: I need the avionics software standards for the satellite bus integration.

candidate_memories.content: The flight computer uses a triple-modular redundancy architecture with a voter on the output bus: three identical compute nodes run the same flight software image and the actuator command is the majority vote of the three outputs, with a misbehaving node rebooted within 200 milliseconds.

Telemetry downlinks are scheduled in 8-minute windows every 90 minutes when the satellite is in view of a ground station, with priority order: housekeeping data first at 10 kbps, payload data second at 2 Mbps, and software logs last if bandwidth remains.
The onboard time synchronization uses GPS-disciplined oscillators with a 1 PPS signal distributed over the spacecraft bus with less than 10 microseconds of jitter between nodes.
The star tracker algorithm uses a lost-in-space pyramid algorithm with a 5-arcsecond accuracy and a 2 Hz update rate for attitude determination.
All flight software patches must pass a hardware-in-the-loop simulation with 1000 randomized fault injection scenarios and a 48-hour soak test before uplink authorization.
An autonomous orbit determination mode using on-board GNSS and a Kalman filter for position-velocity-time estimation during ground station blackouts is being added.

current_user_input: How does the propulsion system throttle calibration and the mission abort boundary work?

candidate_memories.content: Throttle calibration runs a 15-second sweep from 40 to 100 percent thrust at 5 percent increments on every pre-flight static fire, and the computed thrust curve must stay within 2 percent of the reference curve or the engine is marked for maintenance.

The mission abort boundary is defined as: vehicle tilt exceeding 15 degrees from the planned trajectory vector, loss of 2 out of 3 engine controllers, or chamber pressure dropping below 85 percent of nominal for more than 500 milliseconds, any of which triggers an autonomous abort with a 50-millisecond decision loop.
The propellant tank pressurization uses autogenous pressurization with a closed-loop helium backup that activates if ullage pressure drops below 3 bar absolute.
All telemetry packets are checksummed with CRC-32 and transmitted over a CCSDS-compliant protocol with Reed-Solomon forward error correction at a code rate of 223/255.
The range safety system receives a heartbeat from the flight termination system every 100 milliseconds; missing 3 consecutive heartbeats triggers a flight termination command from the ground segment.

current_user_input: What is the claims fraud detection model and the policy underwriting rule engine setup?

recent_context.content: The risk team is reviewing the fraud and underwriting systems.

candidate_memories.content: The claims fraud detection model scores every claim at FNOL with an XGBoost ensemble trained on 5 years of adjudicated claims, using features for claimant network graph density, injury-to-vehicle-damage ratio, and temporal proximity to policy inception.

The underwriting rule engine evaluates policies against a decision table with 350 rules organized in 12 risk modules, and any declination must return the specific rule ID and evidence threshold that triggered it for regulatory reporting.

All claims above 50,000 dollars require a senior adjuster review within 24 hours, and claims above 250,000 dollars require a committee review with the chief claims officer before any settlement offer is extended.

The policy administration system applies mid-term endorsement changes with a pro-rata calculation at midnight Eastern, and the change is effective on the next calendar day with a 3-day grace period for premium payment.
The catastrophe modeling pipeline runs 50,000 simulated hurricane tracks against the in-force book using RMS RiskLink with a quarterly update cadence.
A subrogation potential analyzer that scans closed claims for recoverable damages and auto-generates demand letters to at-fault carrier is being added.

current_user_input: Which document OCR pipeline and renewal retention strategy are in use?

candidate_memories.content: The document OCR pipeline uses Amazon Textract for structured form extraction with a custom post-processing layer that maps extracted fields to ACORD forms using a confidence threshold of 95 percent for straight-through processing and below 95 percent for manual review queue.

Policy renewal retention triggers a series of 4 touchpoints: an email at 60 days before expiration with the renewal quote, a phone call at 30 days if not responded, a certified mail notice at 14 days, and a non-renewal notice filed with the state DOI at 0 days if unresponsive.
The agency portal uses a headless CMS with a React-based agent dashboard that server-side renders the first paint and hydrates for interactivity.
All agent appointments and license verifications are checked against the NIPR producer database nightly, and any lapse in license triggers an automatic suspension of the agent's binding authority.

current_user_input: What is the 5G beam steering algorithm and the SLA credit calculation policy?

recent_context.content: The network engineering team is documenting the RAN optimization and billing policies.

candidate_memories.content: The 5G beam steering algorithm uses a grid-of-beams approach with 64 antenna elements per panel, switching beams every 5 milliseconds based on UE-reported CSI-RS measurements and a proportional-fair scheduler that maximizes cell throughput while guaranteeing a minimum of 5 Mbps to cell-edge users.

SLA credits are calculated as 5 percent of the monthly recurring charge for each hour of outage exceeding the 30-minute grace period, capped at 50 percent of MRC, and require the customer to file a claim within 14 days of the incident appearing on the network status page.
All cell site maintenance windows are scheduled between 1am and 5am local time with a 72-hour advance notification to affected enterprise customers via the customer portal and email.

The core network uses a cloud-native 5G core with service-based architecture where each network function exposes a RESTful API and service discovery is handled by the NRF with a 30-second health check interval.
The O-RAN RIC hosts xApps for traffic steering and anomaly detection, with the near-real-time RIC running a control loop at 10 millisecond to 1 second latency.
A subscriber churn predictor using call detail records, data usage patterns, and care center interaction sentiment to flag high-risk accounts for retention offers is being added.

current_user_input: How does the eSIM provisioning flow and the roaming partner selection work?

candidate_memories.content: The eSIM provisioning flow uses GSMA SGP.22 RSP with SM-DP+ for profile download, and the activation code is delivered via the carrier app with a QR fallback, requiring the device to complete the profile installation within 5 minutes of code generation before the code expires.

Roaming partner selection uses a steering-of-roaming platform that ranks visited networks by wholesale cost, QoS metrics from the last 24 hours, and any exclusive preferred-roaming agreements, pushing an updated PLMN list to the SIM via OTA SMS within 60 seconds of network attach abroad.

All prepaid balance checks must return within 200 milliseconds as measured at the SCP, and any request exceeding 500 milliseconds triggers an automatic failover to the secondary OCS instance in the paired region.
The IMS core handles VoLTE and VoWiFi with a pool of 24 SBCs fronted by a geographically distributed anycast IP prefix with BGP-based failover.
